comparison.objective: Extend a training handle and engage its detent; candidate commissions a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Withdraw pin, translate telescoping member, and re-engage detent versus recessed tool use, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and torque-controlled set-screw locking.
comparison.success_condition: Measured extension with pin kept clear then positively engaged versus two dynamically acceptable stops and witness-tested setting retention. Handle record omits extension and engagement thresholds.
comparison.reason: A latch-and-translate sequence does not test response-guided damping adjustment.
